business_problem: IBM HR needed to replace fragmented, multi-channel support and repetitive manual work with a single service experience that could answer policy questions, execute transactions, and route complex cases consistently across a global workforce.
solution_summary: IBM evolved AskHR from a virtual assistant into an agentic HR support layer powered by IBM watsonx Orchestrate and deep enterprise-system integration. The service exposes more than 7,000 policy pages and automates more than 80 HR tasks through a conversational interface that classifies employee prompts with compliant large language models, routes them to the right HR domain, and either triggers a backend task or returns an AI-generated answer in the user’s preferred language. Behind the scenes, AskHR connects to systems such as Workday, SAP, Concur, and SAP SuccessFactors so employees can retrieve payslips, submit vacation requests, obtain verification letters, or receive personalized payroll and policy guidance, while managers can initiate transfers or organizational updates. The two-tier operating model keeps routine work with AI and escalates only complex needs to human advisors, giving IBM a hybrid digital-labor pattern for HR service at global scale.

solution_components.name: AskHR agents
solution_components.role: Provide the employee-facing conversational experience and execute automated HR tasks across domains.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx Orchestrate
solution_components.role: Adds generative AI and agentic automation so AskHR can classify prompts, route work, and trigger HR workflows.

solution_components.name: Workday
solution_components.role: Supplies enterprise HR data and workflows that AskHR uses for employee support.

solution_components.name: SAP
solution_components.role: Supports backend HR and payroll process integrations used by AskHR.

solution_components.name: Concur
solution_components.role: Provides travel-related workflow context and transactions for AskHR automations.

solution_components.name: SAP SuccessFactors
solution_components.role: Enables manager workflows such as employee transfers and organizational updates inside AskHR.

data_flow: An employee or manager submits an HR question in natural language, watsonx Orchestrate classifies it and routes it to the relevant HR domain, AskHR generates a compliant response or triggers a workflow in Workday, SAP, Concur, or SuccessFactors, and only the more complex requests move to human advisors.
business_outcome: AskHR reduced HR operating cost, cut support tickets sharply, achieved high containment and manager adoption, and shifted the HR operating model toward hybrid automation without removing human support for complex needs.
